_source: PDF cover page prints 'Report #336' and '20th October 2026, Monday' — but 20 Oct 2026 is a Tuesday, and every internal cross-check (this PDF's own trend-chart trailing labels ending 'Mon, 19-Oct', the Cloop Real-Time extraction note stamped 'Tuesday, 20th October 2026' i.e. the usual next-business-morning snapshot, the Staff & Doctors on Leave page's own header reading 'This week, 19th October 2026 until 23rd October 2026', and Report #336 following directly from Report #335/2026-10-16-Friday with no other business day between) converges on the report's true date being Monday 2026-10-19, not the 20th. Filed under the corrected date; the title/date-field mismatch is the source PDF's own error, not ours. Data below is read directly from the full-version PDF (page 1, Critical Daily Tasks) and the short-version PDF (page 1, identical content, both user-uploaded).

Finance's trend does NOT chain-match cleanly: positions 0-6 match, but positions 7-8 (labelled 'Thu 15 Oct' and 'Fri 16 Oct' on THIS report's own chart) print 88% here, conflicting with the 100% already recorded for those same two dates in the already-built 2026-10-15 (committed) and 2026-10-16 (scratch, not yet committed) files — both of which were built directly from each of those dates' own cover badges.
